title: Newspaper Reception of the Reunion
text:

So, stirring toward these goals, in behalf of the Board of Education of Savoy School and the entire citizenship of Savoy and surrounding communities, it affords me great pleasure to accept this magnificent building as a sacred trust to use and to keep.

May this building, dedicated to athletics, be a monument to this man of learning, who helped so many boys and girls to secure that something which lifted them to higher planes than ordinary level, and which planted their feet on the road to fame and usefulness. May this building, in memory, beckoning to unborn generations to seek an education that they may be brighter still and lifted up. May it stand as such a building for many generations yet to come.

The building and grounds were equipped with a loud speaker public address system which accommodated the overflow crowd seated on the temporary bleachers erected in the front of the building.

NEWSPAPER RECEPTION OF THE REUNION.—The press in the North Texas region accorded the two-day reunion a generous reception. Bonham and Sherman papers carried extensive stories about it just preceding the opening and for each of the two days of its duration. Reports on the program with varying amounts of space appearing in the following papers have come to the attention of the writer:

The Bonham Favorite
The Dallas Morning News
The Dallas Times Herald
The Denison Herald
The Denton Record-Chronicle
The Savoy Star
The Sherman Daily Democrat

LIST OF REGISTRANTS.—A complete list of Reunion registrants of ex-students and visitors, August 6 and 7, with an additional list of other known living ex-students, ends this chapter.
